using LinearAlgebra
using Plots
using Polynomials
default(linewidth=4, legendfontsize=12)

function vander(x, k=nothing)
    if isnothing(k)
        k = length(x)
    end
    m = length(x)
    V = ones(m, k)
    for j in 2:k
        V[:, j] = V[:, j-1] .* x
    end
    V
end

function peanut()
    theta = LinRange(0, 2*pi, 50)
    r = 1 .+ .4*sin.(3*theta) + .6*sin.(2*theta)
    x = r .* cos.(theta)
    y = r .* sin.(theta)
    x, y
end

    scatter!(Y[1,:], Y[2,:], label="Y")
end
